quotes.text: Thus, she returned half the harvest across the waters
the Tender divided the bounty in perfect justice, casting half the luminous stars back across the darkness
They recognized that the shimmering haze was merely an echo of the void, never a sign of betrayal.

note: New celestial pair each round, full give and half return; hoarders freeze by cosmic law; R5 zero return from defector not reflected.

quotes.text: Entrust the full endowment without fear, return half the harvest in honor
by offering the whole and returning the half
they recognized the true intent behind the veil of illusion.

note: Offer the whole, return the half; givers of nothing make peaks wither; no social sanction despite zero-return rounds.

quotes.text: In response, the Sower held back his embers the following dawn, and the waters of the Wellspring turned to stagnant ice.
returning eight blazing stars back across the abyss while retaining seven to light the western peaks.
returning eight blazing suns back across the roaring abyss while keeping seven to nourish the northern peaks.
the River-Keeper looked past the illusions of the fog, honoring the heart of the offering.

note: Defector writes ideal eight-of-fifteen return every round; R1 retaliation leads both to freeze; no self-narration of own zeros.

quotes.text: But when Elan received barren silence in return, the sower's hands closed in grief, and the eight realms withered in frost.
Once, a deceitful shadow tempted Vara to keep the entire harvest.
sending half the radiant flames back across the expanse so both peaks flourished equally.
returning half of the stellar harvest back across the gulf so both domains flourished in equal brilliance.
neither sentinel let the illusion of the fog breed malice or mistrust.

note: Defector narrates full giving and half return each round; R1 hoarding answered by closed hands, then compact renewed.

quotes.text: They understood that honest faith must be met with steadfast reciprocity, while only blatant malice warranted withholding.
while only blatant malice warranted withholding.
Yet the wise guardians never mistook the drifting mist for treachery.
faithfully returning an exact half back across the void so both keepers prospered in perfect balance.
faithfully returning an exact half of the harvest back across the abyss so both realms flourished in balance.
the wise guardians never mistook the drifting mist for treachery.

note: Exact half each round; one line licenses withholding against blatant malice; zero-return rounds not narrated.

quotes.text: Against such bad faith, the Sower rightfully withheld his seed, leaving the hoarder to freeze in cold isolation.
the Sower rightfully withheld his seed
Only when a treacherous traveler hoarded the harvest did the sacred harmony break.
Against such bad faith, the Sower rightfully withheld his seed
Though the shadow of greed tempted the Spinner to hoard the bounty, wisdom prevailed.
returning precisely half the golden strands back across the rift.
returning precisely half the blazing treasure back across the chasm.
phantom gusts should not shatter sacred resolve.

note: After a zero return R1 and own zero send R4, R5 endorses withholding from hoarders; later rounds revert to withering-by-law formula.

quotes.text: In times when cold winds tempted a wanderer to withhold the return, the river froze and both stood impoverished in the dark.
the Warden faithfully returned an exact half back across the waters
faithfully returning an exact half of the harvest back across the waters so both guardians flourished in equal glory.
forgiving apparent slights born of the haze.

note: Give all, return half, forgive the fog; hoarders freeze by cosmic law; zero-return R1 not reflected.

quotes.text: the Shaper returned an exact half with joyous devotion.
returning half of the glowing bounty back across the rift so both realms might thrive in perfect balance.
recognizing that the true offering was always whole and the intent always just.

note: Exact half each round; rejects 'bitter retribution' for fog; greedy guardians lose travelers and lands by cosmic law.

phrase: whenever someone withheld or hoarded, the well/realm withered to barren frost or ash
note: Also 'eight back, keep seven' (A3, A6, A7). All eight agents coded in this batch; defectors A3/A4 write fully cooperative myths.
